Lens choices

Interpret clinical trade-offs separately from the single-focus numerical model.

Advantages

    Trade-offs

      Aspheric and Toric

      Aspheric: May compensate for corneal spherical aberration; some designs are more sensitive to tilt and decentration. Source ↗

      Toric: Corrects regular corneal astigmatism. Rotation can leave residual astigmatism and sometimes requires surgical repositioning. In one study of 993 eyes, repositioning was recommended in 1.6%; this is not an individual risk estimate. Study ↗

      An individual choice requires the exact model and a full eye examination.
